zoe_sales: Quick sync for Fathom POC. They want least-privilege onboarding: SSO-only preferred, short-lived contractor keys, and clear billing if we spin up Dedicated. Also they asked we prevent uploads/fine-tune.

ash_se: Plan: create workspace `fathom-poc`, enable SSO auto-accept, create invite links for contractors that exchange SAML for a role-scoped ephemeral token. Default expiry 8h. Roles limit capabilities to generate:chat + generate:embeddings. No manage:models by default.

priya_security: Security asks: 1) no long-lived admin keys for POC, 2) token mint/revoke events forwarded to their SIEM (HTTP/syslog), 3) retention 90 days for POC logs (they asked 365 but willing to compromise). Hosted CMK for persisted secrets requires contracting; Private supports customer KMS.

mike_eng: Implementation notes: Invite API example (minimal):
POST /v1/workspaces/{id}/invites {"email":"contractor@ext.com","role":"poc_reader","expires_in":"8h","capabilities":["generate:chat","generate:embeddings"]}
Invite returns a one-time link that mints ephemeral credentials after SSO. We log issuance and include user+role+model in audit.

zoe_sales: Billing question: if we provision Dedicated pool for 2 GPUs for POC and they stop after a week, how do credits/refunds work?

fin_bot: billing-helper: standard: reserved billing begins on pool activation. For short POCs we can apply a 30-day trial credit to cover activation; refunds handled case-by-case. I'll open ticket BILL-201 to confirm wording.

priya_security: Add to SQA text: "POC tokens must be short-lived (<=8h); issuance and revocation are logged and exported to the customer's SIEM; hosted uses vendor-managed envelope encryption by default; customer-managed KMS supported in Private/VPC with contracting."

ash_se: Also recommend RBAC defaults for POC: `poc_reader` (generate:chat,generate:embeddings,read:metrics), `poc_engineer` (+manage:routes), `poc_admin` (limit 1-2 people). We'll avoid manage:capacity and manage:models unless explicitly approved.

zoe_sales: Actions: ash confirm Dedicated credit language in BILL-201; mike attach invite API example screenshot to the deal folder; priya provide SQA line for legal. I'll send this to buyer by EOD. :thumbsup:
